notes:
Summary: LatticeGrove (ecommerce personalization) evaluating Redwood Dedicated for holiday-scale personalization + real-time chat/ranking. Heavy focus on throughput guarantees (holiday peak), latency SLOs for interactive sessions, and reserved GPU planning to avoid double-booking during promos. They want an explicit SLA for 99th percentile latency and warm cache behavior after failover.

Key contacts: CTO - Fiona Marshall (final signer for SOW), Head of ML - Omar Rahman (technical lead), Infra lead - Ketan Shah (network/security gate).

POC scope (agreed):
- Capacity: reserved pool equivalent to 4xA100 (baseline) with option to burst to 8xA100 for peak days.
- Tests: synthetic baseline, representative prompt sweep, concurrency ramp, 72h soak test at 70% capacity, failover/region cutover simulations.
- Acceptance criteria: p50 chat latency < 80ms, p95 < 220ms under steady 5,000 QPM (chat + reranking mix), embeddings pipeline throughput >= 1,500 qps with batching, no more than 2% token error rate, successful KV cache warmup within 120s after rollout.

Representative prompts (examples captured in Drive): short conversational user intents for product discovery, 512-token product reranking prompts, multi-turn session with session-aware prompts for personalization, bulk embedding jobs (batch size 1024). Team emphasized: "Latencies spike on cold cache is ok if warmup is predictable".

Technical notes (from Diego):
- Want explicit routing policy: prefer local region, fallback to cheaper variant if reserved pool saturated.
- Interested in quantization profile suggestions from Redwood Optimize to reduce GPU footprint for embeddings.
- Prefers VPC private deployment with peered control plane for auditability.

Commercial/SLA notes:
- CFO wants a 12-month reserved commitment with a right to scale at fixed price tiers.
- Legal pushing back on uptime and latency SLA language — wants credits for sustained p95 breaches longer than 30m.
- Pricing sensitivity: target blended cost/token that is ~30% below current AWS-hosted cost.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to deliver formal POC runbook + test harness (ETA 2026-03-12).
- LatticeGrove to sign LOI for reserved pool (internal procurement).
- Schedule 72h soak window and invite infra + GRC to observe metrics.

Quoted lines from calls: "If we can't guarantee tail latency during Black Friday, it's a deal-breaker" — Fiona.

Internal notes: keep POC docs in drive link above; triage INF-1229 for tokenization mismatch seen on reranking model; security ticket SEC-540 open for KMS integration questions.
